claim: an employee clocks in and out from /app/my/attendance, HR enters a record manually, and nothing is left behind

checks.name: precondition: the employee has no attendance record for today
the employee can sign in and reach the app
Clock In creates today's record
Clock In sets clock_in_at and leaves clock_out_at empty
the card offers Clock Out once clocked in
Clock Out sets clock_out_at
worked_minutes matches the actual gap between the two clock times
clock out is later than clock in
the correction request was created
the correction starts pending
it raised an approval request on the attendance_correction workflow
HR can sign in
HR can see this pending correction on /app/attendance/corrections
HR approved the correction
*** the corrected clock-in reads back as the time that was requested ***
*** the corrected clock-out reads back as the time that was requested ***
worked_minutes matches the corrected shift (09:00 = 540 min)
the approved record is marked finalized
precondition: no record on 2026-03-02
the attendance page offers 'Add attendance record'
HR manual entry creates a record
manual entry stores the times in the employee's timezone (the control)
manual entry derives worked_minutes from the entered times
the created record appears in the heatmap
the cell for "Demo Employee" on 2026-03-02 is identifiable
opening an existing record offers Delete
HR delete removes the record
no uncaught page errors during the attendance run
no attendance records leaked
no correction requests leaked
no approval requests leaked

notes: finalized-record guard: exercised only through the UI, never by deleting live rows
